lines.t: I saw you weep alone
Where none could see but me
I saw you choose the narrow road
The wide ones offered free
I saw you give your coins away
To feed the one who could not pay
You call it small, but heaven's the same My hands were yours that day
I saw it, I saw it At every glance that turned to a lie
I saw it, I saw it every time you fought the night
I saw the love the world forgot
I saw the flame that would not die
My beloved
We are now at Upper Session Road
I saw the day you sold your things and placed them in a beggar's hand.
You thought it gone, but I was near and kept it in my plan.
I sowed it, I sowed it
Every seed you sowed unseen
I sowed it, I sowed it
Your quiet faith between
Though weak you feel, though small it seem
I saw your love, your steady dream
My beloved
I saw myself in you
I saw you give me every part
You cried, you feel your name
I saw you trust when others judged
And stood through every blame
I saw the day you laid them down
Your comfort and your crown
You thought you fell but I reached in
And brought your heart back round
I saw, I saw
In your gaze that broke my heart with love
I saw it, I saw it, the way you looked to me above
Each tear, each trembling whispered prayer, each loss you bore in lonely care
My beloved, I saw myself in you
My bride, the time has come And my heart is moved
Your lamp still burns, your race is won You are with me where I am
I saw it all
I am pleased
